description: baseline torch.geqrf for linalg/qr_v2

Replace torch.geqrf with a Triton batched Householder QR path specialized for n=32,176,352, using one program per matrix or panel to cut PyTorch launch overhead while preserving compact geqrf factors.
Initial Triton one-program QR32 Householder path builds but fails n=32 factor residual validation.
Adjusted QR32 Householder sign convention but n=32 still fails factor residual validation.
Moved QR32 tile updates into registers to avoid reload ordering, but n=32 factor residual still fails.
Added a validated Triton n=32 upper-triangular fast path with torch.geqrf fallback; Python structure check made dense benchmark slower.
Implemented a validated Triton one-program QR32 Householder path with corrected sigma-zero diagonal handling, reducing n=32 benchmark to 18.5 us and geomean to 92100.799 us.
Tried num_warps=8 for the QR32 Triton kernel; validation passed but n=32 slowed to 24.7 us and geomean to 94312.119 us.
Restored the faster default/4-warp QR32 launch after 8-warps regressed; best measured geomean remains 92100.799 us.

Best branch head is a3fb29d9 with a validated Triton one-program QR32 Householder path. Best measured score improved from baseline 115764.261 us to 92100.799 us by cutting the n=32 shape from ~318 us to ~18.5 us; final profile is saved for commit 6cfab09c and remains applicable to the restored final implementation. Failed/less useful attempts were initial QR32 sign/update variants that failed validation, a conservative upper-only dispatch that was slower due to Python checks, and num_warps=8 which regressed to 94312.119 us. Next brief should target n=176 or n=352 Triton panel QR, since current branch still falls back to torch.geqrf there and the profile is dominated by large torch geqrf calls.

Combine a3fb29d global-best Triton QR32 one-program Householder path with eef93a9 best structured rank-deficient n=512 classifier: preserve exact QR32 dispatch for n=32, graft the n/2+2 trailing-tiny classifier before the 3n/4 rankdef path for clustered/rankdef n=512, validate mixed dispatch interactions, then profile only remaining non-n=1024 bottlenecks without touching active n=1024 multi-rank work.
Combined the Triton QR32 path with the n=512 n/2+2 then 3n/4 trailing-tiny classifier from eef93a9, intentionally excluding n=1024; validation and guards pass, geomean improves to 85782.872 us.
Tried a single-pass Triton n=512 classifier that emits both n/2+2 and 3n/4 trailing flags; validation passed but geomean was 85849.681 us, slightly slower/noisy than the simpler combined path.
Restored the simpler two-check n=512 trailing-tiny classifier combined with QR32 after the single-pass classifier failed to improve; best measured geomean remains 85782.872 us.

Combine brief completed. Final head e0b14b4e restores the best combined implementation: QR32 one-program Triton Householder plus n=512 n/2+2 then 3n/4 trailing-tiny classifier, with n=1024 deliberately untouched. Best measured score was 85782.872 us, improving over both parents (a3fb29d 92100.799 and eef93a9 107993.582); profile was captured for equivalent commit 3ac87d12. A single-pass dual-rank classifier validated but did not improve (85849.681), so it was reverted. Remaining bottlenecks are dense/mixed n=512 and n=1024 geqrf fallback plus n=176/n=352; future briefs should target those, or integrate worker1's n=1024 work once finished.

Combine parents e0b14b4e9359ce99bb76a0f5ac81dce238c380be and df1d9e3c7066c18552a129989668f8704bf9cbd3: integrate the validated padded power-of-two Triton QR176 path into the QR32+n512 structured-rank implementation, preserving QR32 fallback, QR176 dispatch, and n=512 trailing-tiny/rank dispatch behavior without cross-size regressions; validate dense, mixed, and rank-deficient cases around n=32/176/512, and avoid n=352/n=1024 exploration beyond dispatch isolation.

Integrated the validated padded Triton QR176 path into the QR32+n512 trailing-tiny implementation while preserving n=32, n=176, and n=512 dispatch isolation; validation and guards pass, benchmark geomean improves to 68883.033 us.
Tried num_warps=4 for the padded QR176 Triton kernel; validation and guards passed but n=176 slowed to 2254.8 us and geomean regressed to 73052.252 us.
Restored the faster num_warps=8 QR176 combined path after 4-warps regressed; best measured geomean remains 68883.033 us.

Combine brief completed. Final head 76a3fda1 restores the best combined implementation: QR32 Triton path, padded power-of-two QR176 Triton path with num_warps=8, and n=512 trailing-tiny structured-rank dispatch. Best measured score was 68883.033 us, improving over parent e0b14b4e 85782.872 and parent df1d9e3c 73969.512; final profile is saved for equivalent commit 043c8be3. A 4-warp QR176 launch validated but regressed to 73052.252 us, so it was reverted. Remaining on-brief note: n=352 and n=1024 remain isolated fallback/other-worker territory; future briefs should target n=352 separately or combine completed n=1024 work if validated.

Target remaining dense/mixed n=512 fallback bottleneck by adding a conservative gated blocked n512 QR path: reuse/extend existing Triton QR32/QR176 kernels for panels or trailing-tile updates on well-conditioned full-rank dense n512 cases, validate residual/orthogonality, and preserve all QR32/QR176/trailing-tiny-rank dispatch fallbacks unless this n512 path improves.

Added a conservative Triton n=512 far-tail gate to skip full trailing-tiny scans for dense/mixed fallback cases; validation and guards passed but geomean regressed slightly to 69028.735 us, so this does not improve parent.
Restored the parent QR32/QR176/n512 structured-rank implementation after the n512 dense fallback gate regressed; best score for this brief remains the parent metric 68883.033 us.

Macro brief completed. Tried a conservative Triton n=512 far-tail early fallback gate before the existing n/2+2 and 3n/4 trailing-tiny classifiers; it validated and preserved QR32/QR176/trailing-tiny behavior, but regressed geomean to 69028.735 us versus parent 68883.033, likely due to extra launch/sync overhead on all n512 cases. Final head 75e37fc4 restores the parent implementation with best score 68883.033, and a final profile is saved for 75e37fc4. No improving dense/mixed n512 path found; next n512 work likely needs a real blocked/panel QR update, not more pre-classifier gates.

Tune only the existing QR32 and QR176 Triton kernels from current best: sweep local launch/codegen knobs such as warps, stages, store/mask layout, cache modifiers, unroll/register-pressure hints, and QR176 8-warp alternatives, preserving all dispatch thresholds and non-target kernels; keep only validating variants that improve active-set geomean.
Set num_stages=1 on existing QR32 and QR176 Triton launches while preserving warps and dispatch; validation and guards passed, geomean nudged down to 68882.442 us.
Kept num_stages=1 only on QR176 while restoring QR32 default launch; validation passed but geomean regressed to 68888.869 us, so the prior both-kernel stages variant is better.
Restored the best micro-tuned launch configuration with num_stages=1 on both QR32 and QR176; best measured geomean remains 68882.442 us.

Micro brief completed. Best final head 4db61440 keeps num_stages=1 on both QR32 and QR176 launches, preserving all dispatch thresholds and non-target kernels. Best measured geomean improved marginally from parent 68883.033 to 68882.442 us; profile saved for 4db61440. QR176-only stage tuning validated but regressed to 68888.869 us, so it was reverted. Further QR32/QR176 micro knobs appear near noise floor; larger gains likely need n352 or real n512/n1024 algorithmic work.

Target untouched dense large-shape fallback from 4db6144037ccf302cd6ae21a390389ca923df71d: profile n=2048 batch=8 and n=4096 batch=2 torch.geqrf, then shape-gate exact large dense cases to compare full-batch geqrf versus chunked/per-matrix geqrf with optional CUDA stream concurrency; preserve QR32/QR176/n512/n1024 dispatch exactly, avoid Triton QR rewrites, and keep only if large-shape timings improve without geomean regression.
Shape-gated n2048 batch8 and n4096 batch2 to per-matrix torch.geqrf chunks; validation and guards passed but geomean regressed to 68941.935 us, so full-batch geqrf remains better.
Shape-gated only n2048 batch8 to torch.geqrf chunks of two matrices while leaving n4096 full-batch; validation passed but geomean regressed to 68911.562 us, so chunking does not beat batched geqrf.

Tried per-matrix n2048 torch.geqrf on separate CUDA streams; benchmark looked faster but validation rejected submission.py references to streams because leaderboard bans CUDA streams, so this result is invalid and will be reverted.

Shape-gated only n2048 batch8 to torch.geqrf chunks of four matrices; validation passed but geomean regressed to 68912.977 us, confirming full-batch geqrf remains best among non-stream chunk variants.

Restored the parent large-shape full-batch torch.geqrf fallback after all valid chunked dispatch variants regressed; validation passed and benchmark measured 68890.635 us, consistent with parent/noise while preserving QR32/QR176/n512/n1024 paths.

Manager brief completed. Profiled and explored exact dense large-shape host/library dispatch from parent 4db61440. Valid non-stream chunked torch.geqrf variants all regressed: n2048+n4096 per-matrix scored 68941.935 us, n2048 chunk2 scored 68911.562 us, and n2048 chunk4 scored 68912.977 us versus parent/best around 68882.442 us. CUDA stream concurrency made n2048 faster but is invalid because validation bans stream references, so it was logged as validation_error and reverted. Final head da662c2f07de39a4d1f0ca6f34918f4284dd6629 restores full-batch torch.geqrf fallback while preserving QR32/QR176/n512/n1024 dispatch exactly; final validation passed, benchmark measured 68890.635 us (noise vs parent), and final nsys profile was saved.

Target exactly n=1024 dense/mixed fallback with a low-code-size blocked two-panel QR: preserve existing QR32/QR176/QR352/n512 gates, factor A[:,0:512] via torch.geqrf, apply Q1.T to A[:,512:1024] via torch.ormqr without forming Q, factor A[512:1024,512:1024] via torch.geqrf, assemble LAPACK-style compact H with right-panel reflectors only in the bottom-right block and tau concatenated, and keep only if n1024 improves with no geomean regression.

Added exact n1024 batch60 two-panel library QR using geqrf on the first 512 columns, ormqr on the right half, and geqrf on the trailing 512x512 block. Validation passed, but n1024 benchmark shapes slowed to about 233 ms and geomean measured 67287.560 us.

Reduced-copy variant of the exact n1024 two-panel QR used torch.cat for the first-panel H/right-tail assembly before the trailing geqrf. Validation passed, but n1024 shapes remained about 233 ms and geomean regressed to 67329.583 us.

Restored the parent n1024 torch.geqrf fallback after both two-panel geqrf/ormqr variants slowed the three n1024 benchmark shapes. Validation passed and benchmark measured 66447.302 us, matching or slightly improving parent noise while preserving QR32/QR176/QR352/n512 gates.

Manager brief completed. Implemented the requested exact n1024 blocked two-panel QR using geqrf on A[:, :, :512], ormqr on the right half, trailing geqrf on the 512x512 block, and compact H/tau assembly; it validated but slowed all n1024 benchmark shapes to about 233 ms with geomean 67287.560 us. A reduced-copy assembly variant also validated but regressed to 67329.583 us. Both preserved QR32/QR176/QR352/n512 paths, but neither improved n1024 or geomean, so final head afd0089252a8a1cede848e7076dee0493595e37e restores the parent torch.geqrf n1024 fallback; validation passed, benchmark measured 66447.302 us vs parent 66455.453, and final nsys profile was saved.

Target only dense/uncertain n=512 fallback from bcfa68388a9db114c35986c9fb490c95e60862d8 with an exact low-code-size two-panel library QR: preserve QR32/QR176/QR352 and all existing n512 trailing-tiny/mixed rank gates; for remaining n512 batch640, compare torch.geqrf fallback against geqrf(A[:,:,:256]) + ormqr(Q1.T,A[:,:,256:]) + geqrf(bottom-right 256x256) compact H/tau assembly, trying one reduced-copy assembly variant; keep only if dense or mixed n512 improves and total geomean does not regress.

Added exact n512 batch640 two-panel library QR after existing trailing-tiny and mixed rank gates: geqrf first 256 columns, ormqr right half, geqrf trailing 256x256 block, compact H/tau assembly. Validation passed and benchmark improved geomean to 64238.350 us, driven by dense n512 fallback dropping to about 658 ms.

Reduced-copy n512 two-panel assembly replaces the preallocated H plus left/right slice copies with torch.cat(h1, updated_tail) before writing the trailing 256x256 H block. Validation passed and benchmark improved further to 64204.330 us.
